top_signals.title: The $20 Million Boom in Women's Volleyball
top_signals.summary: Women’s volleyball is attracting serious investment as League One Volleyball sells team ownership stakes at valuations around $20 million. LOVB Pro Commissioner Sandra Idehen joins Bloomberg Open Interest to explain why the sport’s massive youth participation, growing college audiences and emerging star athletes could help turn professional volleyball into America’s next major women’s sports league. (Source: Bloomberg)
